W.note: Rigorous, honest sourcing and a show-cut reverse sear, but long and more steak manual than mammoth play.

X.note: Competent but generic steak with a muddled premise about cooking a real mammoth cut and a stray 'check for parasites' note.

Y.note: Mammoth-as-size-and-story tomahawk carved at table, thorough times and temps, honest about sourcing, though a bit padded.

Z.note: Clean concise recipe with a juniper pan sauce but treats mammoth as a beef steak with only a nod to the animal.
